title: Agitation against CEC will goon till he is removed: Venugopal

ai.summary: Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar continues until his removal, demanding electoral system impartiality and transparency, with plans for nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign to restore deleted voter names.

facts.claim: the Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar would continue until he was removed from the post
facts.quote: AICC general secretary K C Venugopal on Sunday said the Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar would continue until he was removed from the post and the country’s electoral system was made impartial and transparent.

facts.claim: protests were continuing across states and districts, with only a brief pause expected during the Diwali festival
facts.quote: Speaking to reporters here, Venugopal said protests were continuing across states and districts, with only a brief pause expected during the Diwali festival.

facts.claim: the November 1 rally organised by the Congress in New Delhi was described as one of the strongest protests
facts.quote: He described the November 1 rally organised by the Congress in New Delhi as one of the strongest protests witnessed in the country

facts.claim: the party is fighting against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah
facts.quote: he said the party was fighting against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah

facts.claim: the Congress would launch a nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign at the panchayat level
facts.quote: the party would launch a nationwide ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ (Save the Vote, Save the Nation) campaign at the panchayat level over the next one-and-a-half months

facts.claim: the party would appoint a ‘Vote Rakshak’ (guardian) in every polling booth to scrutinise electoral rolls
facts.quote: the party would appoint a ‘Vote Rakshak’ (guardian) in every polling booth to scrutinise electoral rolls, identify people whose names had been deleted and visit their homes to help them get their names restored

ai.background_note: Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar continues until his removal, demanding electoral system impartiality and transparency.
